ui_bugs.issue: On mobile viewport (390x844), the 'Sign up' submit button (data-testid=signup-claim-submit) sits below the visible fold once a roster member is picked (the modal grows with the picker list). Playwright reports 'Element outside viewport' even after scroll_into_view. Real users on iOS/Android can scroll the modal, but consider wrapping the modal body in a ScrollView so keyboard + long roster stay reachable without gesture friction.
